title: BLR uniform string tester
statement: For each integer $n\ge 2$, there is a tester for strings in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ whose seed is a uniformly chosen pair of strings in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The seed determines a BLR constraint and its ordered query scope, and every coordinate of the string belongs to the scope for at least one seed.
caveat: The supplied statement uses the names for the BLR predicate and query scope without giving their definitions, so their exact mathematical content cannot be recovered from this payload.
